name: muraqib-vscode
description: Run Muraqib security, performance and configuration audits from VS Code, with results in the Problems panel and an RTL-friendly report view.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Muraqib reads project files and can contact the configured security URL, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Muraqib audits files on disk and needs a local folder.

muraqib.modules.markdownDescription: Only run modules whose name contains one of these strings (for example `security`, `memory`, `docker`). Empty runs every module.

muraqib.osv.description: Include OSV dependency vulnerability scanning (contacts the OSV service).

muraqib.docker.description: Include Docker discovery and Dockerfile analysis.

muraqib.securityUrl.markdownDescription: URL of a running service (`http://` or `https://`) for HTTP security-header checks. Leave empty to skip.

muraqib.failOnWarning.description: Treat warnings as a failing verdict.

muraqib.maxIssues.description: Maximum number of issues returned by one audit (0 means no limit).

scripts.package: npm run build:core && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
